title: False Positive Prevention & Kill Criteria Protocol
philosophy: Can an attacker do this RIGHT NOW against a real user who has taken NO unusual actions, and does it cause real harm (stolen funds, leaked PII, account takeover, code execution)? If NO, KILL immediately.

seven_question_gate.question: Does this require unlikely user interaction or attacker-controlled local environment?
seven_question_gate.kill_condition: Requires self-XSS, physical machine access, installed malware, or disabling browser security flags.

seven_question_gate.question: Is the target asset explicitly verified to be in-scope and owned by the target program?
seven_question_gate.kill_condition: Asset belongs to third-party SaaS without authorization, CDN edge, or out-of-scope domain.

seven_question_gate.question: Is the alleged leak already public by design?
seven_question_gate.kill_condition: Data is publicly accessible via normal user web UI without auth (e.g. public username, public store items, public blog).

seven_question_gate.question: Is the vulnerability purely theoretical without demonstrated impact?
seven_question_gate.kill_condition: Scanner reported 'Missing security header' (X-Content-Type-Options, Strict-Transport-Security) without exploit chain, or SSL cipher suite warning.

seven_question_gate.question: Does SSRF produce actual internal network data exfiltration or cloud metadata?
seven_question_gate.kill_condition: DNS-only pingback without HTTP response body, no internal access, no cloud IAM credentials.
seven_question_gate.action: KILL unless escalation chain is proven

seven_question_gate.question: Does CORS misconfiguration allow exfiltration of authenticated victim data?
seven_question_gate.kill_condition: Origin reflects arbitrary domain BUT Access-Control-Allow-Credentials is false or omitted (unauthenticated public data only).

seven_question_gate.question: Is the vulnerability reproducible with a clean, minimal Proof of Concept (PoC)?
seven_question_gate.kill_condition: Non-deterministic failure, transient 500 error, or only works under artificial race conditions on local mock.

instant_kill_patterns.pattern: Missing rate limit on general public pages (e.g. contact form)
instant_kill_patterns.reason: Not an Account Takeover or Financial Loss unless OTP/Login bypass is proven

instant_kill_patterns.pattern: Exposed source maps (.js.map) without hardcoded secrets
instant_kill_patterns.reason: Client-side code exposure alone has zero CVSS impact

instant_kill_patterns.pattern: Open redirect alone without OAuth/ATO chain
instant_kill_patterns.reason: Most programs classify standalone open redirects as P5/Informative or out-of-scope
